description: Semantic search in Explore — persist the embeddings ingest already computes, embed the query server-side, and rank by meaning. Substring search is kept and always ranks first. Ships dark behind VITE_SEMANTIC_SEARCH.

userStories.title: Store product embeddings in Postgres
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the embeddings that ingest already computes to be persisted, so search can rank against them.
acceptanceCriteria: New migration file under supabase/migrations/ named with a timestamp later than 20260811120000
Migration runs `create extension if not exists vector`
Creates public.item_embeddings with columns: item_id text primary key, embedding vector(256), model text not null, updated_at timestamptz not null default now()
Creates an HNSW index on embedding using vector_cosine_ops
Runs `alter table public.item_embeddings enable row level security` and creates NO anon policy — service role only, matching catalog_cache
Every statement uses `if not exists` so re-running the migration is safe
A comment block at the top explains why `model` exists: a vector is only comparable to another produced by the same model
Write the migration FILE only. Do NOT run `supabase db push`, `supabase db reset`, or any command that touches the linked remote project — a human applies migrations to production

Also creates public.query_embeddings (query_hash text primary key, embedding vector(256), model text not null, created_at timestamptz not null default now()) with RLS enabled and no anon policy — travel searches repeat heavily ('snorkeling', 'sunset', 'with kids'), so a cache absorbs most traffic and most cost
query_hash is a SHA-256 of the NORMALISED query text (trimmed, lowercased) — the raw query is never stored, so the cache is not a search-history log
Schedules a pg_cron purge of query_embeddings rows older than 30 days, mirroring purge-old-edit-requests
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Write embeddings at ingest instead of discarding them
userStories.description: As a developer, I need viator-cards to persist the vectors it already computes, so the table stays in step with the catalog.
acceptanceCriteria: In supabase/functions/viator-cards/index.ts, after the existing clustering block, upsert one row per item into item_embeddings with the vector and the active model id
Upsert is keyed on item_id so a re-ingest updates rather than duplicating
The write only happens when activeProvider() returns 'openai' (256 dims); when it returns 'voyage' (512 dims) the write is skipped and a console.warn explains why
Rows whose item_id is no longer present in the catalog are deleted in the same pass
A failure of the whole embedding-write block is caught and non-fatal — the catalog response is returned unchanged, matching how writeCache already behaves
No vector is added to the JSON payload returned to the browser
Do NOT run `supabase functions deploy` — a human deploys edge functions

Record in a comment exactly what text is embedded — today `${title}. ${description}` truncated to 500 chars in embeddings.ts — because the search function must embed queries into the same space and any change here silently degrades ranking

Note as a follow-up (not this story): long descriptions can embed to a bland, generic position, which is fine for spotting duplicates and mediocre for search. If golden-set recall is poor, embedding title plus a trimmed description is the first thing to try
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Create the search edge function
userStories.description: As a traveller, I want my typed phrase matched against what activities actually are, so I get results when my words do not appear in any listing.
acceptanceCriteria: New supabase/functions/search/index.ts using the corsHeaders helper from ../_shared/cors.ts
JWT verification stays ON (anon key required) — do not make it a public proxy
Accepts POST { query: string }; returns 400 for an empty query or one over 200 characters
Embeds the query with the same model recorded in item_embeddings.model; if the active provider's model differs from the stored model, return 503 rather than ranking
Returns { results: [{ id, score }] }, at most 30, ordered by cosine similarity descending
Results below a similarity floor constant are dropped rather than padded; the constant is named and commented
The query text is NEVER passed to console.log or console.warn, and never included in any error response body

Rate limited per caller and globally by reusing the edit_requests table and the callerHash/checkLimits approach from supabase/functions/itinerary-edit/index.ts, including failing closed when RATE_LIMIT_SALT is unset
Returns 502 on embedding-provider failure with no partial results
Do NOT run `supabase functions deploy`; the function is verified by typecheck and review, not by deploying it
Before calling the embedding provider, look up the normalised query's SHA-256 in query_embeddings and reuse the stored vector on a hit — a cache hit must make zero third-party calls
On a miss, store the computed vector against the hash. Never store the raw query text
Cache lookups and writes are keyed on the model too; a row whose model differs from the active one is ignored, not reused
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add the client search library behind a flag
userStories.description: As a developer, I need one place that decides whether semantic search is available and calls it, so the UI has no knowledge of the transport.
acceptanceCriteria: New src/lib/semanticSearch.ts exporting semanticSearchEnabled: boolean and searchByMeaning(query: string): Promise<string[]> returning item ids best-first
semanticSearchEnabled is true only when import.meta.env.VITE_SEMANTIC_SEARCH === 'true' AND VITE_SEARCH_FN_URL is set AND VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY is set
searchByMeaning returns [] without fetching when semanticSearchEnabled is false
Every failure path (non-2xx, malformed body, network throw) returns [] and never throws
Query is trimmed and truncated to 200 characters before sending, mirroring the edge function cap
New src/lib/semanticSearch.test.ts covers: flag off does not fetch, non-2xx returns [], malformed body returns []
Add VITE_SEMANTIC_SEARCH=false and VITE_SEARCH_FN_URL to .env.example with a comment saying it must stay off until the Privacy Policy entry is live
Tests pass
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Blend semantic results below substring results
userStories.description: As a traveller, I want a name search to still put that exact thing first, so meaning-matching never gets in the way of knowing what I want.
acceptanceCriteria: New exported pure function blendSearchResults(substringHits: ExploreEntry[], semanticIds: string[], all: ExploreEntry[]): ExploreEntry[] in src/data/exploreItems.ts
Substring hits keep their existing relative order and appear first
Entries matching semanticIds and not already in substringHits follow, in the order the ids were given
An entry present in both appears exactly once, in the substring block
An empty semanticIds array returns substringHits unchanged (assert deep equality in a test)
A semantic id with no matching entry in the catalog is skipped without throwing
Tests in src/data/exploreItems.test.ts cover each rule above including the dedup case
Tests pass
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Arm semantic search on the space bar in Explore
userStories.description: As a traveller, I want single-word searches to stay instant and free, and multi-word phrases to search by meaning when I ask them to.
acceptanceCriteria: In src/pages/Explore.tsx, while the query contains no space character, only substring filtering runs and no network request is made
Once the query contains a space, a hint reading 'press Enter to search by meaning' renders near the search box
The hint appearing does NOT itself trigger a request
Pressing Enter, or clicking the accompanying button, calls searchByMeaning exactly once
Substring results stay live and visible throughout — arming never blanks or delays existing results
While a semantic search is in flight a subtle in-progress state shows and a second submit is ignored
When semanticSearchEnabled is false the hint never renders and searchByMeaning is never called
Results are combined using blendSearchResults from US-005
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill: typing 'Zeerover' issues no request; typing 'good with a toddler' shows the hint and issues no request until Enter is pressed

userStories.title: Handle the armed-but-empty search state
userStories.description: As a traveller, I want to be told when a meaning search found nothing, rather than seeing the same blank page as a typo.
acceptanceCriteria: When a semantic search has run and returned no ids AND there are no substring hits, the empty state says so specifically rather than showing the generic no-results copy
When a semantic search failed (returned [] due to an error rather than genuinely no matches), the copy does not claim there were no results
searchByMeaning distinguishes these two cases in its return type so the UI can tell them apart
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Add the golden query set and its runner
userStories.description: As a developer, I need evidence that the ranking is good before this is enabled.
acceptanceCriteria: tools/search-golden.json with at least 25 queries, each with the ids or title substrings a good result set must contain
Includes the three intent queries that return nothing today: 'good with a toddler', 'something when it rains', 'not too touristy'
Includes name queries that must not regress: 'Zeerover', 'Arikok', 'Baby Beach'
Includes adversarial entries: an empty query, a 200-character query, and a prompt-injection attempt

tools/run-search-golden.cjs reads VITE_SEARCH_FN_URL and VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY from ./.env.production the way tools/run-trace.cjs does, runs each query, and prints per-query recall plus an overall figure
The runner is NOT added to the vitest glob and NOT wired into npm test — CI must stay offline and free
A comment at the top of the JSON states it needs a deployed function and burns real tokens
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Document the enable checklist
userStories.description: As the person flipping the flag, I need the non-code prerequisites written where I will look for them.
acceptanceCriteria: New docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-11-semantic-search-design.md, or an Enable checklist section appended to the PRD, listing every prerequisite

Lists: apply the migration and confirm the HNSW index exists; set the embedding provider key and RATE_LIMIT_SALT as function secrets; run the golden set and record recall; set VITE_SEMANTIC_SEARCH=true
States that the Privacy Policy already names the embedding provider and the query-text flow as of 2026-08-11, and that it must be re-read against what actually shipped before enabling
Adds the search edge function to the data-flow block in .claude/CLAUDE.md
Records the known gaps: no Voyage support, no multilingual testing, similarity floor still unmeasured
Typecheck passes
